info.description:
## 🛣️ Road Damage Detection 2022 (RDD2022) Dataset

The **RDD2022** dataset is a large-scale, multi-national collection of road surface images, designed to accelerate the development of **AI-powered infrastructure inspection systems**.

Released as part of the **Crowd Sensing-based Road Damage Detection Challenge (CRDDC 2022)** — a global initiative to push forward research in automated road damage detection using deep learning.

Timely and accurate detection of road surface issues — such as **cracks** and **potholes** — is crucial for ensuring safe, efficient transportation infrastructure. This dataset empowers researchers, engineers, and practitioners to build and evaluate object detection models for **real-world road condition monitoring**.

The dataset is **pre-split** into **training**, **validation**, and **test** sets — making it ready for immediate use in model development and benchmarking.

---

### 📊 Dataset Split Summary

| Split          | No. of Images | Description                                  |
|----------------|---------------|----------------------------------------------|
| **Train**      | ~26,900       | 70% of the data — used for training models   |
| **Validation** | ~5,758        | 15% of the data — used for hyperparameter tuning |
| **Test**       | ~5,758        | 15% of the data — used for final evaluation  |

---
### 📁 Folder Structure
rdd2022/
├── train/
│   ├── images/
│   └── labels/
├── val/
│   ├── images/
│   └── labels/
├── test/
│   ├── images/
│   └── labels/

- `images/`: Contains road surface images.
- `labels/`: Contains YOLO-format `.txt` annotation files.
